en: Nikkei jumped 1,378 pts to 66,399 today — a report that Micron is ramping up advanced memory sent AI and chip names flying 😳 but here's the catch: 56.9% of Tokyo Prime stocks actually FELL. Advantest and SoftBank Group alone were ~757 pts of it #JapanStocks #investing
